detailed_findings.finding: The bijection V_m -> U_m via c_i mapsto m+1-c_i is correct and establishes |V_m| = E_m for all m, including the m = 0 convention.

The partition by the position of the maximum n is correct: in a U-pattern permutation the maximum can occur only at even positions, and the induced left and right block patterns are both U-patterns when j is even.

The partition by the position of the minimum 1 is correct: in a U-pattern permutation the minimum can occur only at odd positions, and for odd j the right block carries the V-pattern, whose count equals E_{n-j}.

reason: The proof gives a correct and complete self-contained double counting argument. It defines the alternating-up and alternating-down pattern classes, proves they are equinumerous by complementing values, and then counts U_n first by the position of the maximum n (which must be even) and second by the position of the minimum 1 (which must be odd). In each case the decomposition into left and right blocks is correct, the induced pattern on each block is correctly identified, the relabeling argument justifies the factors E_{j-1} and E_{n-j}, boundary inequalities are handled, and the converse reconstruction is bijective. This yields both parity-restricted sums equal to E_n exactly as claimed.
